title: BC Business Corporations Act company compliance obligation pack
description: Draft operational schedules for BC company annual maintenance, records, and securities-register evidence.

rules.title: BC company annual report
rules.summary: Track a BC company annual report from the incorporation or recognition anniversary.

checklist: Review the BC company registry profile as of the anniversary date.
Confirm directors, registered office, records office, and company status.
File the annual report through the BC Registry path.
Archive confirmation, receipt, and profile-report evidence.

rules.caveat: Draft operational workflow; confirm current BC Registry instructions for the company subtype.

rules.title: BC company director minimum review
rules.summary: Review director count and eligibility for a BC company.

authority.displayCitation: BC Business Corporations Act director and records guidance

checklist: Confirm the company has at least one director, or three if public-company rules apply.
Confirm directors are individuals and eligibility evidence is archived.
Archive director consents, resignations, and register updates.
Create corrective tasks for vacancies or missing evidence.

rules.caveat: Public company and subtype rules can change the minimum director count.

rules.title: BC company records and securities register review
rules.summary: Review BC company records, articles, incorporation agreement, resolutions, and central securities register annually.

checklist: Confirm certificates, orders, notice of articles, articles, and incorporation agreement are archived.
Review the central securities register against share transactions.
Confirm shareholder and director minutes or resolutions are archived.
Record corrective tasks for missing records.

rules.caveat: Operational review cadence only; inspection and retention duties depend on record type and company subtype.

rules.title: First BC company AGM deadline
rules.summary: Hold the first AGM within 18 months after recognition.

checklist: Confirm first AGM timing from recognition and any supported waiver or extension.
Prepare shareholder notice and the annual business package.
Preserve minutes or executed unanimous annual resolutions and annual reference date evidence.

rules.caveat: A supported unanimous waiver or deferral must establish the annual reference date.
rules.reviewNotes: Updated from the supplied source-backed research register (retrieved 2026-10-04); qualified legal approval remains required.

rules.title: Subsequent BC company AGM deadline
rules.summary: Hold an AGM in the next calendar year and within 15 months after the preceding annual reference date.

checklist: Confirm next calendar-year and 15-month annual reference date limits.
Prepare notice, annual financials and shareholder business.
Retain minutes or valid waiver/deferral and its selected annual reference date.

rules.caveat: A supported unanimous waiver or deferral must establish the annual reference date.
rules.reviewNotes: Updated from the supplied source-backed research register (retrieved 2026-10-04); qualified legal approval remains required.

rules.title: Director change filing deadline
rules.summary: File a director or prescribed director-address change within 15 days.

checklist: Record the actual director or prescribed-address change date.
Prepare the required director-change notice with the applicable registry service.
File and preserve the registry confirmation and updated register.

rules.caveat: Requires dated event evidence and applicable entity screening; legal review remains required.
rules.reviewNotes: Updated from the supplied source-backed research register (retrieved 2026-10-04); qualified legal approval remains required.

rules.title: Transparency register update deadline
rules.summary: Enter new or changed transparency information within 30 days after awareness.

checklist: Record when the company became aware of new or different information.
Assess indirect control, joint arrangements and applicable exemption evidence.
Update the restricted register within 30 days; preserve reasonable steps and unsuccessful inquiries.

rules.caveat: Requires dated event evidence and applicable entity screening; legal review remains required.
rules.reviewNotes: Updated from the supplied source-backed research register (retrieved 2026-10-04); qualified legal approval remains required.

rules.title: Significant individual status-entry notice
rules.summary: Notify the significant individual within ten days after the status entry.

checklist: Confirm significant or ceased-significant status entry date.
Notify the affected individual within ten days.
Preserve delivery evidence in restricted records.

rules.caveat: Requires dated event evidence and applicable entity screening; legal review remains required.
rules.reviewNotes: Updated from the supplied source-backed research register (retrieved 2026-10-04); qualified legal approval remains required.

rules.title: Transparency register annual confirmation
rules.summary: For applicable private companies, take annual confirmation steps between the recognition anniversary and two months later.

checklist: Confirm applicability and exemption evidence.
Take reasonable confirmation steps during the anniversary-to-two-month window.
Update the restricted internal register and preserve unsuccessful inquiry evidence.

rules.caveat: Screen reporting issuer, listed and prescribed-class exemptions with evidence; there is no verified operational public BC filing duty.
rules.reviewNotes: Updated from the supplied source-backed research register (retrieved 2026-10-04); qualified legal approval remains required.

rules.title: Former significant individual destruction window
rules.summary: Delete former significant-individual information within one year after the sixth anniversary of the cessation entry.

checklist: Confirm cessation entry date and identify all associated register and maintenance records.
Review conflicting holds and other applicable duties before destruction.
Complete and document lawful destruction inside the sixth-to-seventh-anniversary window.

rules.caveat: Plan record-specific destruction; legal holds and applicable exceptions require reviewed handling.
rules.reviewNotes: Updated from the supplied source-backed research register (retrieved 2026-10-04); qualified legal approval remains required.
